name: post-edit-failure-release-frees-the-path
description: KTD-1 release-on-failure, checked by its effect on both backends rather than by its answer: session A takes EXCLUSIVE on a tracked path (preflight pre-edit) and its post-edit reports the tool FAILED (success:false, no content_hash), then session B pre-edits the same path. B's acquire must be clean, the bare {ok:true} with no collision warning, because A's grant is gone. Row 17 pins the answer to the failed post-edit, which a release that did nothing would still give; this row fails instead, because B would find A still holding EXCLUSIVE and get the collision envelope of row 13. Row 15 is the same check for a subagent-scoped stop.
